scope: Independent H I level-resolved E1 transition-rate benchmarks for the state-resolved natural-width implementation.

source.citation: W. L. Wiese and J. R. Fuhr, Accurate Atomic Transition Probabilities for Hydrogen, Helium, and Lithium, J. Phys. Chem. Ref. Data 38, 565-720 (2009).

comparison.quantity: total E1 spontaneous-decay rate from an H I nl term
comparison.note: NIST's critically evaluated multiplet rates include reduced-mass and relativistic effects. StarkZee uses analytic nonrelativistic gross-structure gaps, so agreement is expected within the stated comparison tolerance rather than to numerical identity.
